task.title: Clarify and automate HealthKit Activity Nutrition graduation

result.summary: Fixed two problems. (1) Sep-22 raw-only storage: an older canonicalization policy was still bounded to exactly Sep-21; extended it to a genuine open-ended window, deployed (Server 924d5e55), switched live to open-ended from Sep-22, no backfill. The stored raw Sep-22 observation was permanently barred by anti-backfill design; a fresh resync canonicalized cleanly with zero duplication. Verified live: Sep-22 Activity+Nutrition project correctly; evidence-eligibility scope also activated (nothing graduated yet, day not closed). (2) No background automation existed: Build 50 was 100% manual sync. Built HealthKitAutomaticSynchronizationCoordinator wiring the existing dormant observer/background-delivery APIs, firing on every foreground for Activity+Nutrition. Review found a reentrancy Blocker + 2 Minors, fixed and mutation-tested. Full-suite testing then found a real regression the review missed (Sandbox UI tests broke via an unintended production HealthKit permission prompt); root-caused, fixed, re-reviewed (APPROVE WITH FOLLOW-UPS). Founder reviewed remaining open decisions and authorized Build 51: built, archived, uploaded (VALID), not yet confirmed installed.

tests.summary: Server: full unit suite same count/failures as base (0 new), all 10 phase gates match base, ESLint clean, exact-SHA build succeeded. Native unit: 1272 tests, 0 failures. Native UI (TrainingAcceptanceUITests, full class): 12/12 passed on a freshly-privacy-reset simulator after the Sandbox-regression fix. Every new/changed guard was mutation-tested (reverted, confirmed the corresponding test fails, restored, confirmed clean git status).

review.summary: Server open-ended policy change: independent review approved with non-blocking follow-ups after two small fixes. Native automatic-sync coordinator: independent review returned BLOCK on the first candidate (reentrancy Blocker, two Minors); fixed and re-reviewed on the corrected candidate, updated verdict approved with non-blocking follow-ups. Two Major items (broad auth scope; unverifiable real-device background-wake behavior) remain open by design, documented in code and presented to the Founder as explicit decisions rather than silently resolved.

zero_write_audit.summary: Server policy writes were each preceded by a dry run capturing expected facts and followed by a post-apply invariant check; all other production reads (live graduation verification, authority reverification) ran read-only.

decisions_required: Install Build 51 (delivery 04e929ea-c751-4a84-b4aa-5331f5d6b20d, VALID) once TestFlight processing completes, and confirm automatic Activity/Nutrition ingestion works without visiting the diagnostic screen.
Decide whether to pursue real-device verification of true background wake after full process termination, or continue relying on the foreground catch-up sync as the guaranteed recovery path.
Decide whether/when to start the Workout strength canary (explicitly out of scope for this task; Workout remains fully untouched).
unexpected_findings: Running the full Native test suite (not just the independently reviewed unit test class) surfaced a real regression the review's narrower scope had missed: the automatic sync coordinator reached real Founder Production unconditionally, breaking 12/12 Sandbox-mode UI acceptance tests via an unexpected system HealthKit permission prompt. Root-caused, fixed, and re-reviewed before proceeding.
backlog: Real-device verification of background wake after full process termination (currently unprovable in this environment)

Narrow follow-up: an in-flight background registration from a prior Founder Production session is not torn down on a mid-process switch to Sandbox via the in-app authority picker (narrow, not currently reachable by any test or normal flow)
Workout strength canary (deliberately not started in this task)
Retire/relabel the Founder diagnostic canary controls in production builds, if ever desired (not attempted -- unrequested design change)
recommended_next_step: Founder installs Build 51 via TestFlight and confirms automatic Activity/Nutrition ingestion works with no daily canary toggle and no manual Sync required.
